content: MS Learn rate-limits (updated 2026-07-31): global limit 200 TSTUs per sliding 5-min window; requests are first delayed (up to 30s) then blocked with HTTP 429 TF400733. Headers: Retry-After (seconds, RFC 6585), X-RateLimit-Resource (display only), X-RateLimit-Delay (seconds, 3 decimals), X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining (0 when delayed/blocked), X-RateLimit-Reset (unix epoch), X-RateLimit-Cost. All except Delay are sent BEFORE delays start, often on HTTP 200; docs say honor Retry-After even on 200.
